raw_llm_output: For Well 35/9-5, the NWIS-Sentinel system is currently monitoring for a STUCK PIPE hazard. The risk level for this hazard is UNKNOWN, and no specific risk score or Wilson 95% confidence interval is available. An actionable alert has NOT YET been triggered, remaining in monitoring status, and current depth information is not provided. Top analog offset wells include 35/11-15 S (AHP score=0.922), 35/6-2 S (AHP score=0.918), 15/9-14 (AHP score=0.907), and 34/12-1 (AHP score=0.907). However, no evidence has been retrieved to indicate whether these specific analogs experienced stuck pipe incidents.
